body:
This PR removes the registry from the shared CI depot, so each build downloads a current General into its own depot. Calibration resolves without a manifest, so it failed when CloudMicrophysics v0.48 was registered after the last depot rebuild ([error](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-calibrate-e2e/builds/8583#01a1a7be-560f-4ac0-9ce5-09b6e990bf6e)). I tried to use `Pkg.Registry.update`, but that function only refreshes registries in the top-level (per-build) depot, which had none, so the new version was never visible.

Changes
- Delete `registries/` in build_depot.sh before publishing. I have manually done this for the most recent published depot.
- Remove `update_registry=false` from pipeline.yml and full_pipeline.yml since they now need to update the registry.
- Remove the init `concurrency_group` from `calibration/test/pipeline.yml` since it now uses the readonly depot and won't have concurrency issues.
title: Remove registry from shared depot
